FOOTNOTES

1/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as a Lump Sum by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$3,027,300 and 33.5 FTE Positions from the Barbering and Cosmetology Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.

IT Development

The Baseline includes no funding in FY 2027 for IT Development. Adjustments are as follows:

Remove One-Time FY 2026 Funding

The Baseline includes a decrease of \$(200,000) from the Barbering and Cosmetology Fund in FY 2027 to remove one-time funding for IT Development from Laws 2024, Chapter 250.

Laws 2024, Chapter 250 appropriated \$200,000 from Barbering and Cosmetology Fund for IT Development in FY

2025 and FY 2026. These one-time appropriations are exempt from lapsing, and were not included in the FY 2025 and FY 2026 General Appropriations Acts.

Auditor General Report

In September 2025, the Auditor General published a performance audit and sunset review of the Barbering and Cosmetology Board. The report found that the Board did not evaluate the reasonableness of their licensing and registration fees, resulting in the Board charging fees in excess of its operating costs. The Auditor General recommended that the Board develop and implement written policies and procedures to annually analyze individual fees to determine their reasonableness.
